title: Better Ancient Debris
description: A custom Minecraft resource pack who make Ancient Debris more visible
body:
# 💚 Green Ancient Debris

✨ Make Ancient Debris impossible to miss!

**Green Ancient Debris** is a simple yet effective texture pack that turns Ancient Debris into a bright green variant, making it much easier to spot while mining in the Nether.

---

## 🔍 Features
- 💚 Bright green Ancient Debris texture  
- 👀 Easier visibility in dark environments  
- ⚡ Lightweight & performance-friendly  
- 🎨 Keeps a vanilla-friendly style  

---

## 📦 Why use it?
Tired of missing Ancient Debris while mining? This pack gives it a fresh, highly visible look without changing the core feel of the game.

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility
✔ Works with most versions  
✔ Can be combined with other texture packs  

---

💡 Simple change, big difference.
